metadata.title: When your accidental click turns into an enemy uninstall moment in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Clicked like a maniac, got a kill I totally did NOT deserve.
Enemy probably rethinking life choices right now.
Click if your aim’s on vacation but the game still hands you a win!

Tap if your aim ever ghosted but you still got the kill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
